prompt.title: What players fill in
prompt.description: E.g. "How many points did you score at darts?" The number they fill in is added to their total as points.

penalty.title: Points deducted for a number above the maximum
penalty.description: Taken off a player's total when they fill in more than the maximum, and the challenge closes for them (you can open it again for them in the Run tab). Players are not told about this beforehand.

allowImprove.title: Players may improve their score
allowImprove.description: They can fill in a better number later (e.g. after another round); only their best counts.
